QUOTE: `code`: reads are fine but writes are unsafe, so restart the client. A rebuild cannot fix it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that on the code axis reads are fine while writes (rebuilds) are unsafe, and that a stale process can't be used to rebuild. It doesn't say that the database is opened per call or that a build would write old pipeline logic. It gives the read/write asymmetry itself, which is the substance of the item.
